summary.text: Carla Schuessler is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 61, who assumed office on November 14, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as chief operating officer of Complete Legal Defense Team and executive director of Habitat for Humanity of Horry County.

paragraphs.text: Schuessler was born in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and earned a B.S. from Illinois State University in 1996, according to Ballotpedia.

Her career experience includes serving as chief operating officer of Complete Legal Defense Team and as executive director of Habitat for Humanity of Horry County, and she served on the board of directors of the Myrtle Beach Area Chamber of Commerce.
Schuessler assumed office on November 14, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists her on the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
Carol Goodman (D) and David Herndon (Libertarian Party) are also on the November 3, 2026 ballot for District 61.
